question: On what materials must the diagram for the alienation rite be written?
premises: A diagram is to be written for this rite.
The writing surface includes cloth of the dead.
It involves a feather placed outside.
inference: One should write the diagram on cloth of the dead and on a feather that has been set outside.
uncertainties: The exact ritual preparation implied by bahiṣkṛte is somewhat unclear.
plain_english: One should write the diagram on cloth from the dead and on a feather set apart outside.
